page: OVHcloud c2-120 is a compute-optimized server powered by an Intel x86_64 processor with 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs. Running on a KVM hypervisor, this instance features a 3.0 GHz clock speed, 120 GB of RAM providing 3.75 GB per core, and a 400 GB local SSD. The CPU architecture is based on the Intel Haswell microarchitecture without TSX and operates with one thread per core, meaning Hyper-Threading is disabled. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps, and the server includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark data indicates average performance across most standard compute and memory tasks. The server achieves a multi-core stress-ng score of 49032.04 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 11504.0. Notably, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression shows strong performance in the top 25% at 253.18 GB/sec. However, LLM text generation tasks represent a significant bottleneck, with the 135M model performing poorly at 37.21 tokens/sec and the 7B model showing weak performance at 6.29 tokens/sec. Memory bandwidth is measured at 113.21 GB/sec for large block read-only operations and 38.36 GB/sec for large block write operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c2-120 offers a high density of dedicated physical cores relative to its memory footprint, making it a viable option for CPU-bound workloads that do not require hyper-threading. The bundled 400 GB SSD and 10 Gbps network baseline provide balanced local I/O and network throughput. This configuration is well-suited for multi-threaded data decompression, software compilation, static web serving, and general-purpose parallel processing, while it is less optimal for memory-intensive databases or modern LLM text generation workloads.
description: OVHcloud c2-120 is a compute-optimized server featuring 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs on an Intel x86_64 Haswell architecture running at 3.0 GHz. It is equipped with 120 GB of RAM, a 400 GB local SSD, and a 10 Gbps baseline network interface. Operating on a KVM hypervisor with Hyper-Threading disabled, the server delivers average performance across most standard compute benchmarks, including a Geekbench multi-core score of 11504.0. It exhibits strong multi-threaded bzip3 decompression performance at 253.18 GB/sec, though it shows weak to poor results in LLM text generation. The c2-120 provides a resource-dense profile for CPU-bound tasks, making it highly suitable for software compilation, static web serving, and multi-threaded data processing workloads that benefit from dedicated physical cores without hyper-threading.
